rounds: Free returns for online shopping should be banned.
Strawberries in December are a luxury we should give up.
Shoppers care more about price than about where something was made.
Every product should show how far it has travelled to reach the shop.
Globalisation has made life better for most people.
Online shopping has been bad for city centres.
Buying second-hand is better than buying new.
Delivery companies should pay a fee for every van they send into the city centre.
